title: Curvature growth of some 4-dimensional gradient Ricci soliton singularity models
authors: Bennett Chow, Michael Freedman, Henry Shin, Yongjia Zhang
description: Curvature estimates for four-dimensional gradient Ricci soliton singularity models, using geometric analysis and topological arguments.

title: Iterated-sumset spectra: The complete exponent law and its rank geometry
description: Determines the growth exponent of the number of possible h-fold sumset sizes for fixed-size integer sets, together with sharp bounds for integer models preserving finite additive relations. Also proves the formula conjectured in OEIS A227589 for minimal labelings of identical four-sided dice that maximize the number of distinct sums.

title: Open full-metric formation and local marked first-order asymptotic moduli of FIK blowdown singularities
description: Formation of FIK singularities under Ricci flow and the local parameters governing their first-order asymptotic behavior.

title: A global girth obstruction for Garg–Mineyev taiko product structures
description: A global obstruction to the Garg–Mineyev triple-girth route to zero-divisor and unit counterexamples in group rings over F₂, proved through incidence geometry.

title: From rough local mass to logarithmic spectral ladders for damped waves
description: Local damping mass, resolvent bounds, and decay, including spectral asymptotics near logarithmic damping wells.

title: Exchange identities and symmetric slices of the valley Delta conjecture
description: Exchange identities and symmetry for the area-zero and area-one slices of the valley Delta generating function.

title: One extra edge forces Berge pancyclicity
description: Berge cycles of every length from a Hamiltonian Berge cycle and one additional edge, in the stated large-order uniformity regime.

title: Hilbert-90 quotient maps, torsion defects, and symmetric monodromy
description: Rational maps from Hilbert-90 descent: cancellation, torsion, and characteristic-zero monodromy.

title: Coset-refined trace statistics, nodal characters, and affine branches in cubic norm tori
description: Trace distributions on cosets in cubic norm-one tori, including singular fibers and local branch geometry.

title: Logarithmic source curves in polynomial fiber products
description: Geometry at infinity of polynomial fiber products, rational lifts, and their arithmetic counting behavior.
